notes.title: Cat Quest III | Tavern Tales Update Out MEOW!
notes.content:
Ahoy, fur-midable adventurers! 🐾

The meow-velous free update, Tavern Tales, has arrived in Cat Quest III!

[previewyoutube=LgxO2Jwcir8;full][/previewyoutube]
Hoist the sails and head to the Tavern, tap on the mic and purr-pare for Cappey to retell the tales of how you defeated the Pirate Lords. Cappey may have taken some creative liberties and added some exaggerations, but isn’t this how the best tales are told?

Upon completing each tale, you will unlock a companion to join your crew! Your new crew mates are various species of parrots with their own abilities and traits that join and fight beside you on your adventures! Now you can be a bonafide pirate with yer very own parrot, yarr~!


New Content:
⚔️ 5 Tavern Tale boss fights, including a secret one that only unlocks after completing all the tales.
🦜 5 unlockable Crew Mates
🏴‍☠️ More Wanted posters for completing new bosses that were added in previous updates.
🎁 A new trinket is given by Mama Milka for defeating the Dragon Boar.


Steam Summer Sale
It’s that time of the year when the sun is shining and you’re looking to stay cool, and what better way than to sail the high seas in Cat Quest III, which is now 40% off!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2305840/Cat_Quest_III/ 

Patch Notes

 Added the new Tavern Tales mode! Fight remixed versions of the Pirate Lords and win the loyalty of new crew mates!
 Added a 'Fast Furwards' toggle in the Options. (Only unlocked after completing 'Fast Furwards' in Mew Game)
 Added 'Large Text' mode in the Options.
 Added a new Trinket; Mama Milka's Special!
 Added new Wanted Posters to claim rewards from!
 Tweaked the Defense stat to be more balanced at high and low levels.
 Tweaked the Equipment scaling to be higher in New Game + and beyond.
 New Game+ now raises the enemy level by 100 instead of 80.
 Minor Balance tweaks to certain bosses.
 Minor adjustment to sound effects for certain weapons.
 Fixed minor localization errors.
 Created a fallback for an error that occurs when the user's files are not readable due to a lack of permissions.

notes.title: Cat Quest III | Mew Game Mode Out MEOW!
notes.content:
Ahoy, meow hearties! 🐾

Hoist the sails and get ready to embark on a more challenging catventure with Mew Game Mode!

[previewyoutube=s3Bd4RQCP1o;full][/previewyoutube]
Listen up ye purrywags! Mew Game Mode allows the player to add a variety of unique meowdifiers to their game for a more challenging experience.

Conquer the seas of the Purribean in Mew Game Mode and earn some treasure for completing it. The more meowdifiers selected, the greater the reward! 🐾⚓

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44155993/5ece7c42066121a155111b4b68e3262f6117dd4b.jpg

Meowdifiers

🐱 Nine Lives - You can only 'Game Over' nine times. After which, the game kicks players back to the main menu and deletes the save file.

🏴‍☠️ Ruffer Enemies - Different and more powerful enemies appear.

🐾 Naked Paws - Armor and weapons cannot be equipped. Trinkets still can be equipped.

🔮 Purre Magic - You can only cast spells. Mana regenerates automatically and quickly.

🚫 No Leveling - You cannot level up.

⏩ Fast Furwards - Everything moves at twice the speed. Even you.

⚔️ No Upgrades - You cannot upgrade anything, not even spells.

🚢 Furriendly Ship - Your ship does one damage.


Patch notes

 Shield dodge animation has been tweaked to look more unique.
 Slightly reduced the damage of Mewteor and Ice Paw.
 Bug fix: certain items were given at too high a level.

notes.title: Nominate Cat Quest III in the Steam Awards!
notes.content:
Hey fur-midable adventurers!  

We’re over the meow-n to announce that Cat Quest III is eligible for the 2024 Steam Awards, and we need YOUR support to pounce on some amazing nominations! Our pawsome community has always been the heart of this journey, so we’re asking for your help.

We think we are the cat’s whiskers for the Best Game on Steam Deck award! Getting steam deck verified was an early must-have for us and we've been thrilled to see so many of you with the Purribean in the palm of your hands. 

Other Furtastic Categories:


Outstanding Visual Style: For the pawsitively mewnique art that makes the game a feast for the eyes!  
Sit Back and Relax: Because who wouldn’t want to zen out with some claw-some adventuring?  


A million thanks to all of you for being such an amazing community. We couldn’t have made it this far without your love, laughter, and un-fur-gettable support. 

Simply visit our Steam page and click the “Nominate” button to choose Cat Quest III for these awards. Every vote makes a huge difference!  ! 

With love,  
The Gentlebros 🐾

notes.title: Cat Quest III | Mew Content Update Out MEOW!
notes.content:
Ahoy, fur-midable adventurers! 🐾

The Purribean just got paws-itively better with a free update for Cat Quest III! 

[previewyoutube=Tr0prD3X63M;full][/previewyoutube]

Prepare to hoist the sails and embark on a treasure-filled journey packed with purr-rific new content:
☠️ Five New Side Quests – Sniff out secrets, meet claw-some new characters, and paw-sibly cross paths with some familiar furry faces!
🏴‍☠️ Four New Dungeons – Test your whiskers with new puzzles, claw-ver gameplay mechanics, and thrilling surprises waiting to be unearthed!
🐾 Three New Boss Fights – Face off against fearsome foes in heart-pounding battles that’ll have you clawing for glory!
💎 New Gear Galore – Gear up for adventure with shiny new loot that’ll have you pouncing into action with style.

It's time to conquer the seas of the Purribean once more! 🐾⚓

New Content

 5 new quests.
 4 new dungeons.
 9 new equipment (Including a second Warrior's Braid for more co-op fun!)

QOL Additions


 Leveling up past maximum level now replenishes health, mana and ammo.
 Added "Camera Shake" option in Options.

Bug fixes


 Fixed rare issue where NPCs would move at abnormal speeds sometimes.
 Fixed French Localization where there are missing characters from certain words (Eg. Charaibes -> Charabes).
 Fixed issue where some enemies' attacks can cause the player to not be able to transition from water>land and vice versa.
 Fixed issue where there was a short static at the end of skipping animated videos.
 Fixed Credits not being reset back to initial starting point.
 Fixed confirmation message panels not hiding properly sometimes after confirmation ("Yes").
 Adjusted sound effects to fade out during transition between scenes.
 Fixed issue where certain passives were not functioning properly with certain equipment.

notes.title: Patch notes for v1.1.8
notes.content:
Fixed Golden Helm's bonus still being capped at 30% instead of 20%.
 Fixed issue where Mewtallica Boss' headgear was not working as intended.
 Fixed issue where players could sometimes sink underground in the Infinity Tower.
 Fixed issue where players could sometimes pause the game during cutscenes & get stuck.
 Fixed Necropawmicon quest being tied to the chest instead of the trinket itself.
 Edited puzzle stones to not reset when sleeping at Rest Beakons.

notes.title: Hotfix patch v1.1.7
notes.content:
Fixes issue where player may get stuck in combat mode if changing scene after certain attacks are used on enemies.
 Fixes issue where full screen text can get cut off in certain languages.

notes.title: Hotfix for v1.1.6
notes.content:
Fixed issue where player cannot give the Necropawmicon to complete a quest.


For the full patch list for v1.1.6, please see the main Patch Notes for v1.1.6!

notes.title: Patch notes for v1.1.6
notes.content:
Fixed issues where a small number of players experienced save file problems. Save files now migrated to a new location. Please contact us at contact@thegentlebros.com if you are experiencing issues during this migration!
 Fixes an issue where shooting from a gun could cause the wrong swing from a melee weapon to trigger.
 Fixes a few mistakes in the localization.
 Fixes an issue where the Necromouser's chest cannot be looted under specific circumstances.
 Fixes an issue where players could get stuck in the Eight Bit Dungeon.
 Changed the drop condition for Weird Mushroom and Flame Crystal. They will now always drop from two specific bosses in the Infinity Tower.
 Fixed issues in Spicy Cave.
 Fixed issue where the Def stat was affecting healing.
 Fixed issue where cutscenes were too loud and not tied to the Music sliders in the Options.
 Fixed issue where some players were experiencing stuttering.
 Fixed issue where icicle attacks were larger than expected.
 Fixed issue where bounty gold rewards are higher than intended in New Game+.
 Fixed issue where some achievements were not retroactively unlocking.
 Fixed issue where boar footsteps could still be heard when sound was turned off.
 Fixed issue where the level display in the inventory is not correct.
 Fixed issue where the Electric Cannonpaw attack could stunlock enemies.
 Fixes minor issues in Co-op mode.
 Balance tweaks to Golden Helm, Spicy Squid set and Takomeowki set.
 Added an extra cutscene before the fight with Captain Takomeowki.
 Confined mouse cursor to gameplay space in Fullscreen mode and Windowed mode.
 Minor bug fixes

notes.title: Small Paw-tch! Day 1 fixes!
notes.content:
Ahoy, me hearties!

We've just deployed a small patch for some bugs that have popped up since our launch earlier today!


 Fixed Softlock in co-op if one player jumps into a ship while the other starts a cutscene at the same time
 Fixed the volume on the Prologue cutscene so it is no longer too loud
 Fix for spelling error on Necropawmicon description.


We hope you have a pawsome time! 

Thanks so much, 

The Cat Quest III Crew

notes.title: All A-pawd! Cat Quest III has landed ashore!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=JoIGmxVr0P8;full][/previewyoutube]

Set sail in this 2.5D open-world action RPG and brace yourself for a meow-nificent journey filled with furry fun and adventure. Play alone, or locally with a friend, and defeat those troublesome Pi-Rats. 

Dive into a paw-geous new world with varied dungeons, biomes, and furr-ociously fun gameplay! Engage in fierce battles with a refined combat system featuring tighter attack combos and weapon swapping, and more customisation than ever before! Purrrrrfection.

Dress Fur Battle!

Discover trinkets from around the world to transform your character into a fur-midable Pi-rat beating Powerhouse! Experiment with dozens of gear sets, weapons, spells, and trinkets to purr-fect your ultimate build. You can even kit your ship out with some claw-some weapons!

For the fur-st time in the series, command your very own ship! Explore the seas, seamlessly zip to shore, and traverse the land on paw to hunt for booty. Discover treasures, furr-ocious spells, and gla-meow-rous costumes!

Uncover the secrets of the North Star. Cat Quest III is Out Now on Steam, and we are so excited fur you to get your paws on it. 

Paws Truly, 

The Gentlebros
